5636-winding-paths.title: Winding Paths
5636-winding-paths.creator: Gertrude Page
5636-winding-paths.description: A book by Gertrude Page. When Hal was fifteen, Lorraine left; and it has to be admitted that the anxious, motherly hearts of the Misses Walton drew a deep breath of relief, and hoped the friendship would now cease, unfed by daily contact and daily mutual interests. But there they under-estimated the depth of affection already in the hearts of the girls, and their natural loyalty, which scorned a mere question of separation, and entered into one another’s interests just as eagerly as when they were together.

arxiv-1612-04989.title: Electronic correlation effects and Coulomb gap in the Si(111)- ( 3 × 3 ) (\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}) -Sn surface
arxiv-1612-04989.creator: A.B. Odobescu, A.A. Maizlakh, N.I. Fedotov, S.V. Zaitsev-Zotov
arxiv-1612-04989.description: Abstract Electronic transport properties of the Si(111)- ( 3 × 3 ) (\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}) -Sn surface formed on low doped Si substrates are studied using two-probe conductivity measurements and tunnelling spectroscopy. We demonstrate that the ground state corresponds to Mott-Hubbard insulator with a band gap 2 ​ Δ = 70 2\Delta=70 meV, which vanishes quickly upon temperature increase.

arxiv-2202-05368.title: Uniaxial stress effect on the quasi-one-dimensional Kondo lattice CeCo 2 Ga 8
arxiv-2202-05368.creator: Kangqiao Cheng, Binjie Zhou, Cuixiang Wang, Shuo Zou, Yupeng Pan, Xiaobo He, Jian Zhang, Fangjun Lu, Le Wang, Youguo Shi †, Yongkang Luo ∗
arxiv-2202-05368.description: Abstract Quantum critical phenomena in the quasi-one-dimensional limit remains an open issue. We report the uniaxial stress effect on the quasi-one-dimensional Kondo lattice CeCo 2 Ga 8 by electric transport and AC heat capacity measurements. CeCo 2 Ga 8 is speculated to sit in close vicinity but on the quantum-disordered side of a quantum critical point.

arxiv-2211-08305.title: Microstructure sensitive fatigue life prediction model for SLM fabricated Hastelloy-X Journal: International Journal of Fatigue
arxiv-2211-08305.creator: Chandrashekhar M. Pilgar, Ana Fernandez, Javier Segurado
arxiv-2211-08305.description: Abstract A microstructure-sensitive fatigue life prediction framework based on CP-FFT is proposed to study SLM fabricated Hastelloy-X. The microstructure enters in the model through the shape, size and orientation distributions of grains in the RVEs, which are generated from experimental EBSD data.

arxiv-2304-02461.title: Many-Exciton Quantum Dynamics in a Ruddlesden-Popper Tin Iodide
arxiv-2304-02461.creator: Esteban Rojas-Gatjens, Hao Li, Alejandro Vega-Flick, Daniele Cortecchia, Annamaria Petrozza, Eric R. Bittner, Ajay Ram Srimath Kandada, Carlos Silva-Acuña
arxiv-2304-02461.description: Abstract We present a study on the many-body exciton interactions in a Ruddlesden-Popper tin halide, namely ( PEA ) 2 ​ SnI 4 \text{(}\text{PEA}\text{)}\text{}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{2}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{2}}\text{}}\text{SnI}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{4}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{4}}\text{}} (PEA = phenylethylammonium), using coherent two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy. The optical dephasing times of the third-order polarization observed in these systems are determined by exciton many-body interactions and lattice fluctuations.

arxiv-2412-07482.creator: Yossi Ben-Zion
arxiv-2412-07482.description: Abstract Seemingly we are not so far from Star Trek’s food replicator. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly becoming an integral part of both science and education, offering not only automation of processes but also the dynamic creation of complex, personalized content for educational purposes.

arxiv-2504-03473.title: Doubly heavy tetraquarks from lattice QCD: incorporating diquark-antidiquark operators and the left-hand cut
arxiv-2504-03473.creator: Sasa Prelovsek, Emmanuel Ortiz-Pacheco, Sara Collins, Luka Leskovec, M. Padmanath, Ivan Vujmilovic
arxiv-2504-03473.description: Abstract Lattice studies of the doubly-charm tetraquark T c ​ c = c ​ c ​ u ¯ ​ d ¯ T_{cc}=cc\bar{u}\bar{d} require the determination of the D ​ D ∗ DD^{*} scattering amplitude, which most often incorporate only meson-meson interpolators. We additionally incorporate diquark-antidiquark operators and find that these have some impact on certain eigenenergies.

arxiv-2509-00851.title: Spectrum Cognition: Semantic Situation for Next-Generation Spectrum Management Thanks: This work was supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant 62222107, in part by the Yangtze River Delta Science and Technology Innovation Community Joint Research (Basic Resear
arxiv-2509-00851.creator: Hao Zhang, Fuhui Zhou
arxiv-2509-00851.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hao Zhang, Fuhui Zhou. In response to the growing complexity and demands of future wireless communication networks, spectrum cognition has emerged as an essential technique for optimizing spectrum utilization in next-generation wireless networks. This article presents a comprehensive overview of spectrum cognition, underscoring its critical role in enhancing the efficiency and security of future wireless systems through the innovative perspective of “data processing to signal analysis to semantic situation”.

arxiv-2510-06507.title: A Meat-Summer Night’s Dream: A Tangible Design Fiction Exploration of Eating Biohybrid Flying Robots CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI
arxiv-2510-06507.creator: Ziming Wang, Yiqian Wu, Qingxiao Zheng, Shihan Zhang, Ned Barker, Morten Fjeld
arxiv-2510-06507.description: Abstract . What if future dining involved eating robots? We explore this question through a playful and poetic experiential dinner theater: a tangible design fiction staged as a 2052 Paris restaurant where diners consume a biohybrid flying robot in place of the banned delicacy of ortolan bunting.

arxiv-2511-11612.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Workload Mapping and Scheduling in Heterogeneous HPC Systems
arxiv-2511-11612.creator: Aasish Kumar Sharma, Julian Kunkel
arxiv-2511-11612.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly investigated for technical reasoning, yet their capacity to perform structured, constraint-based optimization purely from natural-language input remains insufficiently understood. This study evaluates 21 publicly available LLMs on a representative heterogeneous High-Performance Computing (HPC) workload mapping and scheduling problem.

pmc-11520226.creator: Takao Miki, Satoshi Ohki, Ryo Yamaguchi, Ayako Nagasawa, Shuichi Okonogi, Kiyomitsu Yasuhara, Tamiyuki Obayashi
pmc-11520226.description: Myxomas are the most common type of benign cardiac tumors, and the right atrium is the second most common location among them, with an incidence ranging from 8.6% to 20% of all cardiac myxomas. Herein, we described a rare case of right atrial myxoma originating from the inferior vena cava orifice.

pmc-12386968.title: Long-Term Effectiveness of a Monofocal Intraocular Lens (IOL) Enhanced for Intermediate Vision: A 5-Year Follow-Up Study
pmc-12386968.creator: Rita Mencucci, Giovanni Romualdi, Alberto Carnicci, Fabio Panini, Matilde Buzzi, Fabrizio Giansanti
pmc-12386968.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: The Tecnis Eyhance is an enhanced monofocal intraocular lens (IOL) designed to improve intermediate vision without compromising distance clarity or increasing the incidence of photic phenomena. Although short-term results have been encouraging, long-term data remain limited. This study presents the 5-year follow-up of a previously published 6-month clinical evaluation, aiming to assess the stability of visual, optical, and patient-reported outcomes over time. Methods: A single-center retrospective study of 18 patients (36 eyes) undergoing bilateral Tecnis Eyhance IOL implantation was conducted.

pmc-12679006.description: BACKGROUNDAcute pancreatitis (AP) is a frequent gastrointestinal emergency characterized by inflammation. It has the potential to progress to organ failure.
